term_types.name: Control or sufficient influence over an arrangement
term_types.question: Who retains control or sufficient influence over the rules, operations, assets or ability to shut down a product, which determines regulatory responsibility?
term_types.description: The FATF guidance and Section Two use control or sufficient influence, including via smart contracts or administrative keys, as the criterion determining who bears AML/CFT obligations for DeFi and stablecoin arrangements.

values.definition: Party retaining control via parameters, admin keys, fees, or ability to change rules, thereby bearing VASP obligations.

term_types.question: Which illicit-finance risk category (ML, TF, PF, sanctions evasion, predicate offence) does a VA-enabled activity most relate to?
term_types.description: Section Two categorises VA-enabled illicit activity into predicate fraud, money laundering, terrorist financing, proliferation financing and sanctions evasion, often converging on shared infrastructure.

term_types.name: Offshore VASP licensing approach
term_types.question: On what basis is an offshore VASP required to be licensed or registered in a host jurisdiction?
term_types.description: The passages contrast traditional incorporation/location-based licensing with an activity-based approach that captures offshore VASPs actively serving residents, sometimes requiring material local presence.

values.definition: Registration required where a VASP actively provides services regardless of physical presence, anchored by targeted marketing or domestic payment rails.

citations.section: Section Two: ML/TF/PF Risks (stablecoins, P2P/unhosted wallets, offshore VASPs, DeFi)
citations.quote: requiring oVASPs to register where they actively provide services regardless of physical presence, with regulatory anchors including targeted marketing

values.value: Location of creation / place of business
values.definition: Licensing required in jurisdiction where the VASP is created or, for natural persons, where their place of business is located.
